pages.title: Mirror Alloy Ingot
pages.text: Matter and antimatter grains alternate in it like a chessboard, each pair held apart by its own Penning field. It hums, and it is warm.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)If the field that keeps a grain of anti-iron from touching iron can be made small enough, the two can share an ingot. The Foundry makes it so.

Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Mirror Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Baryogenesis Seed, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma.
